race.description: Bundaberg Rum Super Showcase Mdn Plate
race.comment: FRENCH MELODY (7) lived up to the three good trials with a tough on-pace third on debut over 1100m at Ipswich. Can come on further now from the good gate over the extra ground. Top three contender. ZOUBUCA SHOTS (9) resumes after making good progress at her second race start when sitting on the speed to finish a close up second over 1200m at the Gold Coast. Has trialled well and the blinkers go on from the low draw. Expected to go close. CAUTIONARY TAIL (1) comes back in grade and trip after going under narrowly over 1350m at Doomben. At his peak now and stays in the mix. FAWUNDERPAR (4) has been thereabouts in the three career starts. Chipped away late when third over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast. Best figures measure up over the extra trip.
